query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS publication_molecule_links (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  publication_id INT NOT NULL,
  molecule_id INT NOT NULL,
  relationship_type ENUM('studies', 'mentions', 'analyzes', 'synthesizes') DEFAULT 'mentions',
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_link (publication_id, molecule_id)
);
